# netbox_console_port_template (Data Source)

A console port template of a device type or module type (dcim.consoleporttemplate).

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/dcim/consoleporttemplate/):

> A template for a console port that will be created on all instantiations of the parent device type. See the console port documentation for more detail.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_console_port_template" "test" {
  name = "test-console_port_template"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `created` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `device_type_id` (Number) Id of the device type. Set exactly one of device_type_id and module_type_id; NetBox rejects both and neither.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `label` (String) Physical label.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `module_type_id` (Number) Id of the module type. Set exactly one of device_type_id and module_type_id; NetBox rejects both and neither.
- `name` (String)
- `q` (String) Search term, matched against the fields NetBox searches for this object type.
- `type` (String) Port type as its NetBox slug, e.g. de-9, rj-45, usb-a (any of NetBox's console port type choices).

### Read-Only

- `url` (String)
